flex_base.label: Crushed recycled concrete sub-base
flex_base._note: $480 per truck delivered = $33/yd material + $150 delivery. Rule of thumb: 10 yd per 1000 SF turf. Each truck holds 10 yd; partial loads still incur full $150 delivery.

seam_tape.label: Seam tape
seam_tape._note: TurfHub: 100' rolls $0.34/LF; 1000' bulk rolls $0.24/LF. Auto-switch to bulk above 300 LF.

turf_roll._note: TurfHub turf sold in 15' wide rolls cut to length.

bender_board.label: Bender board (black or brown)
bender_board._note: BendaBoard BP Texturized 1"x4"x20' = $25.95/stick (TurfHub AccBendaBP-BL, confirmed 2026-05-27, was $24.95). Sold only in 20' increments.

silica_sand_infill.label: Silica sand infill
silica_sand_infill._note: Premium Silica 12/20 ~$6/bag, ~50 SF coverage per bag

nails.label: 5" nails
nails._note: Auto-scaled: 1 box per 1,800 SF. Price verified 2026-04. Was $55 in Jan.

bender_board_stakes.label: Pre-drilled stakes (12")
bender_board_stakes._note: Auto-added when bender board included: 1 stake per 2 LF

labor.label: Installation labor
labor._note: $3/SF or min day rate, whichever higher. Min covers 2-man crew + truck for small jobs.

putting_green_labor.label: Putting green labor
putting_green_labor._note: Replaces standard labor for PG portion only

cage_install._margin_note: 23% gross margin = 20% target margin + 3.5% credit card fee buffer. Math: net after card fee = sell × 0.965; want net margin 20% → sell = cost/(0.80×0.965) = cost/0.772 → 22.8% gross → round to 23%.
cage_install._note: Day-based install pricing benchmarked against assemblyandrepair.com, lfssportsnetting.com, battingcagesinc.com. Concrete-set HD frames add 1 day of labor.

putting_green_upcharge.label: Putting green specialty labor (cup-cutter rent, base detail, fringe seam)
putting_green_upcharge._note: Reduced from $3 since hardware is now itemized below

shock_pad.label: Shock pad 8mm (fall-rated)
shock_pad._note: Required for Playground (fall-height rating); optional upsell for Pet Turf

settings._floors_note: Tiered floors and benchmarks calibrated from 82 closed-won estimates ($458k revenue). Floor = warn-below; benchmark = median realized $/SF for that size bucket.
settings._note: Defaults calibrated from 2026 YTD P&L: 24 jobs, avg margin 27.06%, 'other' costs ~9.3% of revenue (~10% of direct cost)

company.name: Bearcat Turf
company.warranty: 15-year turf manufacturer warranty. 1-year Bearcat Turf installation warranty.
